effective_only_after: owner-reviewed PR approval and separately recorded adoption decision
primary_hardware: owner RTX 4070 Laptop GPU 8 GiB, system RAM measured
optional_portability: larger machines and explicitly authorized hosted APIs; not an extra required phase

legacy_accounting.rule: historical evidence stays authoritative; never transfer credit into this proposal

gates_rule: Each milestone requires all gate_tasks independently verified with artifact-level evidence; proposed/in_review work earns zero completion. Research decisions can be verified without code, experiments require real receipts, and acceptance requires owner decision.

phases.name: Efficient 8 GiB image generation and useful batches
Reproducible LoRA/style and private appearance experimentation

milestones.title: Research decision: model and runtime on 8 GiB
milestones.objective: Choose one lawful real model/graph and reproducible comparison plan; no claim of model compatibility before an observed run.

milestones.title: 8 GiB reproducible baseline
milestones.objective: Obtain correctly authorized, independently inspected repeatability evidence on the current laptop; no generic GPU-tier claim.

milestones.title: Measure one useful optimization
milestones.objective: Determine whether one backend-supported change improves a predeclared memory/time objective without unacceptable image loss.

milestones.title: Useful 10-image batch
milestones.objective: Install and run a local generation -> inspect/select -> export path on the owner's real system with receipt-bound failure handling.

milestones.title: Human-accepted local workflow
milestones.objective: Demonstrate a reviewed accepted-image yield and clear resource/recovery report with realistic install instructions and licence boundaries.

milestones.title: Research: LoRA and conditioning options
milestones.objective: Choose legal, locally feasible LoRA and subject-conditioning methods from actual backend capabilities.

milestones.title: Reproducible style and LoRA variation
milestones.objective: Produce a pinned, controllable experiment grid where each variation has traceable model/LoRA state and measured memory cost.

milestones.title: Private appearance experimentation
milestones.objective: Safely create and review controlled personal-reference variations locally without claiming accurate real-life prediction.

tasks.acceptance: Compare a pinned lawful model, stock ComfyUI, other applicable runtimes and opt-in image APIs with source-linked applicability/rights and explicit unknowns.
Approve model, image size, objective quality criteria, host-RAM/VRAM stops and apples-to-apples benchmark protocol; no inference implied.
With separate fresh permission, execute only the exact bounded one-startup/three-run P08-A03 contract; retain true machine/recipe/timing hashes and honest failure evidence.
Independent review of real receipt, run provenance, outcomes, peak sampling limitations, safety/rights and whether the specific 8 GiB configuration is actually repeatable.
Choose ONE supported optimization after baseline, with hypothesized memory/time impact and downside/quality test plan; do not pretend it is already faster.
Implement reversible opt-in scheduling/offload/tiling configuration with capability checks, synthetic tests and no hidden GPU/API work.
Compare unchanged model/seed/size/steps on actual 8 GiB laptop before/after; report VRAM, host RAM/commit, elapsed time, failures and blinded quality judgment.
Expose minimal pip-installable local recipe run -> manual selection -> ZIP/report for 10 real generated images without manual source edits or a new graph editor.
Implement/verify bounded journal resume, interruption handling, model/source identity and no silent re-generation of completed items for this small batch.
Run a separately authorized 10-image local batch on 8 GiB laptop; retain exact recipe, failures/retries, time, peak sampled resource use, output hashes and candidate gallery.

Human-score the real 10-image batch against success criteria recorded before its run; disclose accepted yield, quality failure modes and seconds per accepted image. Compare practical Prehnite value against the same ComfyUI-only work (manual steps, reproducible selection/resume), without claiming image quality speedups that actually come from changed model settings.

Accept/reject documented local install instructions, checkpoint/LoRA rights and honest limitations; explicitly separate this local product acceptance from the old 90-image/paid-billing release obligations.
Choose one legal compatible local base model and LoRA combination; research scale/order/loading, measured-memory requirements, provenance and source license.
Approve controlled style and user-reference editing experiments and privacy boundaries; identify what identity consistency tests can and cannot prove.
Pin base/LoRA hashes, scales, prompt/seeds and backend compatibility in recipe/journal; refuse missing/changed adapter files.
Generate a controlled local parameter grid/contact sheet where one studied dimension changes at a time; preserve all provenance.
Run owner-authorized multiple-seed style experiments on 8 GiB GPU; measure memory/load latency and blind human consistency rating.
Provide local-only opt-in self-owned reference import, no implicit uploads, no mandatory external account and explicit original-image retention policy.
Run a small approved set of haircut/beard/hair-color variations with locally stored inputs; preserve source model/LoRA/edit-strength/seed provenance.
User reviews requested variation adherence and identity consistency; outputs labeled simulations, never predicted actual changes; verify no external transmission.
